name: EarthViora
tagline: Explore the planet through useful environmental measurements and practical map-ready tools.

tool.title: Rainwater Harvest Calculator
tool.intro: Estimate how many liters of rainwater a roof can collect from a rainfall event.
tool.formula: A 1 mm rainfall over 1 square meter equals 1 liter. The efficiency factor accounts for losses.
tool.caution: Rainfall, catchment area and collection efficiency must reflect local conditions. This is not flood forecasting.
